verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an identity platform, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows Auth0 can be self-hosted. The closest offering, Private Cloud, is explicitly a vendor-managed dedicated cloud service on AWS or Azure, which is an adjacent deployment option rather than customer self-hosting. Community comments point to competitors such as FusionAuth for self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
